tools.name: find_epub_fix
tools.description: Given a Kindle or EPUB problem (rejected by Send to Kindle, no cover, want a new cover, file too large, wrong title or author, or validate before sending), returns the FixMyEPUB tool that fixes it, whether it is free, and a link. The tools run in the reader's browser; the book is never uploaded.

tools.name: send_to_kindle_troubleshoot
tools.description: Diagnoses an Amazon Send to Kindle problem from its symptom and returns the most likely cause, what to do next and a guide link. Same decision rules as fixmyepub.com/tools/send-to-kindle-troubleshooter/.

tools.name: explain_epub_error
tools.description: Explains an EPUBCheck code or validation message (for example PKG-007, RSC-005, OPF-003) or a Kindle conversion error: which layer of the EPUB is broken, why, and the repair steps in order.

tools.name: kindle_epub_limits
tools.description: Facts about sending EPUB files to Kindle: size limits per route, cover requirements, DRM, and what Kindle reads from the EPUB (title, author, cover metadata).

tools.name: generate_fixed_layout_code
tools.description: Generates EPUB 3 fixed-layout (pre-paginated) package metadata, the XHTML viewport tag and page CSS for a page size in pixels.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_epub_fix" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
